ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 25-35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated along leading edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white bands along the leading edges of both lobes; dense clusters of white speckles at the distal tips; largely uniform black pigmentation in the central region surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees; depth is moderate, creating a clear bisection of the fluke surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations at the distal tips; mid-lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate irregularity; smoothing to low-amplitude undulations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge; trailing edge displays a consistent concave sweep from tip to notch on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) detected primarily at the distal tips and scattered across the interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-left lobe, appearing as white streaks against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, irregular margins at the distal tips of both lobes with associated high-intensity encrustations; potential bio-fouling or scarring from barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical white pigmentation patterns following the leading edge boundary on both fluke lobes.
